title: Release Plan (top-level YAML front-matter of a test-plans/content/releases/<release>.md file)
description: Structured metadata for a release test plan. The markdown body below the front-matter contains the '## In-scope cases' and '## Outcomes' sections, which are parsed separately by the CLI.

release.description: Release identifier: 'R<N>' for weekly releases (e.g. 'R31'), 'R<N>.<patch>' for hotfixes/patches (e.g. 'R31.1'). Used verbatim as the subdirectory/file name in the dashboard.

target_date.description: Target ship date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; used by the landing page for ordering.

description.description: Free-form summary of the release's testing scope; rendered at the top of the per-release view.
